plain_english_policy: This bill is a resolution urging state officials not to sue over federal healthcare laws.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would produce no change in Alabama law or policy because the text explicitly states it urges other branches of government (the Governor and Attorney General) rather than creating new mandates. It serves as an internal statement of position by the House of Representatives regarding a federal issue.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors (Representatives Hall, Baker, etc.) affirmatively advanced this resolution to express their opposition to state-level litigation against federal healthcare reform.
evidence_quotes: "URGING GOVERNOR BOB RILEY AND ATTORNEY GENERAL TROY KING NOT TO PURSUE LITIGATION AGAINST THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT"
"BE IT RESOLVED BY THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES... That we hereby urge and exhort Governor Bob Riley and Attorney General Troy King to resist any efforts to engage in antidemocratic lawsuits"
